title: Windows 11 Healthcare Endpoint Baseline (Intune)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (multi-component Windows 11 baseline within Intune for clinical endpoints; configuration + security + update + power tuning).
hook: One proven Windows 11 baseline for every clinical and corporate endpoint
problem: Moving a hospital or clinic fleet to Windows 11 without a defined baseline means every device drifts: inconsistent security settings, power options that put shared clinical PCs to sleep mid-shift, missing update behavior, and no documented standard to audit against. This solution gives you a single, repeatable Windows 11 endpoint baseline delivered through Microsoft Intune — configuration profiles, the settings catalog, a referenced security baseline, update behavior, and power/display tuning for always-on shared clinical devices — assigned once and inherited by the whole fleet.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — what a Windows 11 baseline is, the configuration profile + settings catalog + security baseline model, update behavior, and power/display tuning for shared clinical vs. personal corporate devices.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, supported Windows 11 edition/hardware, device groups, a referenced security baseline) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: device groups, configuration profiles, the settings catalog baseline, the security baseline reference, update rings, power/display profiles, then pilot, validate, and expand.
5 PowerShell scripts — baseline-readiness discovery, per-device baseline validation, a fleet baseline-drift report, safe remediation of drift, and a baseline-target group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A single, repeatable Windows 11 endpoint baseline for clinical and corporate devices, delivered through Microsoft Intune — configuration, security, update, and power tuning, assigned once and inherited fleet-wide. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A single, repeatable Windows 11 endpoint baseline for clinical and corporate devices via Intune — configuration, security, update, and power tuning assigned once and inherited fleet-wide.
meta_description: Standardize Windows 11 clinical and corporate endpoints in Intune: configuration profiles, settings catalog, security baseline, update rings, power tuning. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts.
bottom_line: Every Windows 11 endpoint on one documented, auditable baseline — consistent security, update, and power behavior for shared clinical and corporate devices alike — proven on a pilot before you scale.
